props.optionDesc-general_input_offset: Add an offset to notes strumtime for people, with ruthless speakers playing offset
props.optionDesc-downscroll: Toggle on to make arrows go down
props.optionDesc-hints: Simple hints may appear in various places to provide assistance.
props.optionDesc-allow_shaders: Shaders used everywhere across game, turn some of them off if your pc performs bad.
props.optionDesc-lowquality: Removes different objects and sprites from menus and stages for better performance for low-end computers.
props.optionDesc-show_judges: Toggle to see you notehit ratings (Sick, good, etc.)
props.optionDesc-show_healthbar: Toggle to see how much hp you have/your and your opponent icons
props.optionDesc-flashing_lights: If your epileptic, you better turn this off
props.optionDesc-subtitles: When enabled, subtitles appear during some songs and cutscenes
props.optionDesc-camera_zooming: Toggles ability for camera to do beat-zoom
props.optionDesc-notesplashes: Toggle splash on you sick hit and sustain hold
props.optionDesc-framerate: On how much fps game runs.
props.optionDesc-language: Changes A LOT OF texts/sprites to a different languages
props.optionDesc-haxeflixel_intro: Cool new Haxeflixel logo intro on game boot
props.optionDesc-debug_display: Toggle to see your FPS, MEMORY and ETC
props.optionDesc-naughtyness: switches the display of vaguely dangerous content, probably
props.optionDesc-gpu_load: 90% of sprites will load through GPU
